paragraphs: Rabbi Elazar or Rabbi Yose ben Delagai. [Yoma 39b](https://www.sefaria.org/Yoma.39b.13) and [Tamid 30b](https://www.sefaria.org/Tamid.30b.7).[^1][^2]

notes.text: Yoma has Rabbi (Yose ben) Dulgai. Tamid has Rabbi Elazar ben Diglai. The consulted [Mishnah Tamid](https://www.sefaria.org/Mishnah_Tamid.3.8) reads Eliezer ben Diglai.

[Heilprin’s Elazar entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=511&lang=en) and [his Yose entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1917&lang=en) both quote the account of the goats and incense under different names.
